sourceText:
Brown Butter Pretzel Peanut Blondies
By: Sarah Kranz
Published: Friday, February 17, 2017 - 4:07pm

Ingredients




1 stick (8 tablespoons) unsalted butter
1 cup light or dark brown sugar
1 large egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
1 cup all-purpose flour
½ cup pretzel pieces
½ cup mini peanut butter cups

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 8 x 8 baking pan with aluminum foil, then grease the pan. 2 In a small saucepan melt the butter over medium heat. Once the butter has melted, continue to cook it until it is golden brown in color (~5-10 min). 3 Once you have browned the butter take the pan off the heat. Then add the brown sugar and vanilla. Next add the egg, stir until incorporated. 4 Add the flour and salt to the saucepan and mix until just incorporated. Add the pretzel pieces and mini peanut butter cups and stir until these are equally distributed. 5 Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick is clean when inserted into the center of the pan. 6 Cool on a wire rack, then cut into 16 pieces and serve!

About

Chewy and rich, these buttery blondies are the perfect canvas for the salty sweet combination of pretzels and peanut butter cups.
